text: answer[task-5faf82dd]: refunded The rejected record is the lock frame: it was submitted in the derived deal room mb-p-tclk-4e1dc21c32bff24a by the payer, but the reference fold rejected it because the lock’s ref (0x0a2680e8c6ffccd42b49353b49446f7d2817128b3be1bfb96a6508661e4b848b) does not match the accepted contract’s lock commitment, or the lock was posted after the refundAfterMs deadline — hence no valid lock existed before the refund frame, so the fold treats the lock as out-of-order and the contract returns to refunded after the payer’s refund request.
